text_block_list.text:
—Its main melody is...
"Duramente"...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All the performers are assembled.
Now, raise your baton and conduct!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a rough yet beautiful session!
—Now, shall we begin!

The day of the Japan Cup—
The venue was packed with even more fans than usual.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Will someone take down Duramente...
or will Duramente reign supreme
as the absolute strongest!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Duramente!
I can't even imagine her losing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaan Blaaack--!!
Beat your destined rival and set off some massive fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If you win here,
everyone will take pride in your strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Win this, Duramente.
...I'm leaving it to you—"

Three years spent running alongside Duramente.
It's still too early to look back, but... this day will undoubtedly mark a major milestone for her.

The girl who was once fragile and unsteady is no more.
In both mind and body, she is approaching completion—
becoming the vessel of the "strongest."
choice_data_list: (I wonder if I've gotten closer, too.)
(I wonder if I've gotten a little closer too.)

text_block_list.text:
After the Japan Derby, I made Duramente
give up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...
Have I grown at all since that time?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We
are "the same."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We looked in the same direction and walked the same path.
When we trembled, we took each other by the hand...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Lend me... a hand.

Pulled by Duramente, my fist pressed against her heart.
I could feel her pulse, thumping with intense vitality—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Entrust it to me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Entrust all of yourself to me.
It will become my blood, coursing through my veins—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —It will become the strength that leads to victory.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Do not fear crushing others.
Do not hesitate to break them.
For all such worries are entirely groundless."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What you see is not a dream.
It is the future. A predetermined future.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am Duramente.
What flows through this body—is the absolute strongest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
...What will you entrust?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm,
Dura-san is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Ah, passione...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: What is reflected in those eyes is flame... Even though I am the one looking at you? Angelo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: S-Sounds of Earth-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have been eagerly awaiting
today's splendid ensemble.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I won't ask you to make me your concertmaster.
Just for now... won't you be
my one and only señorita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeeeek!?
D-Dura-san!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cheval.
Oh, so you were the one who called for me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, yes...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And so?
What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
………………No.
Never mind, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I look forward to working with you,
today. That's all—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Your toughness is truly remarkable.
I'm looking forward to seeing how far you can push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Um...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm... just a tiny,
unimportant Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not strong like Duramente-san,
Kita-san, or Crown-san."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Just when I thought I could finally walk my own path,
everyone in my generation is so incredible...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there were times I thought...
'If only I wasn't in this generation.'

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even someone like me...
Even I can...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm... an umamusume.
I can't just give up just because I can't win...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um, so...
And then... well.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
What am I even saying?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It must be a declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Of course I accept, Cheval.
I am fully prepared for this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hit me with everything
you've got inside you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My... ultimate strength...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Never forget that look in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes—
will prove she is the strongest!
